verdict.rationale: Lowenstein Sandler is a law firm with a digital presence: it publishes an llms.txt file and offers a Clerky-powered formation workflow. Publishing an official MCP server is therefore a plausible ask, and the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence documents an MCP server, and the OpenAPI probe found no API surface (all candidate paths returned 404), so the capability is unevidenced.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
